mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 61 degrees under clear skies at Fireman's Park. We have a Waxing Gibbous moon tonight, and the International Space Station will be visible starting at 3:24 AM for one minute, rising over Mount Horeb and tracking toward Fitchburg and Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona has two major updates: Public Works is hiring an Engineering Technician to oversee infrastructure projects until September 20th, and the city has implemented new sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover rising maintenance costs for our vital systems.

We have a busy weekend ahead with live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company today, plus a Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena today. Tomorrow, you can drop into yoga at Insight Wellness.
In a notable incident from Friday, August 15th, a 44-year-old driver was arrested for a first offence O W I after officers discovered her passed out at the wheel near North Main Street.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Cashew. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM, so get ready to grab a scoop then.
